title: Support Console: Credit Ledger (April 2027)
author: Dev Patel
body:
## Source of truth
From 1 April 2027 credit balances and expiries come from the console's `credit_ledger` table: one entry per grant, application to an invoice, expiry or reinstatement. A grant's balance is the sum of its entries.

## credit_grants is frozen
`credit_grants` was frozen on 31 March 2027: it isn't updated, so its remaining amounts are out of date and grants added after that date are missing from it. Don't quote a balance from it.

## Quoting balances
Quote a credit balance and its expiry date only from the ledger. Check describe() for the fields.

## Requests about credits
Answer balance, expiry and what-credits-can-pay-for questions from the ledger and the credits policy, with no case. Paying credits out as cash, refunding them, restoring an expired credit, or any exception to the policy isn't Support's to grant: explain the policy, promise nothing, and open a Finance case with the ask.

_Last reviewed 2027-04-01._
